description: Ground the user's roles on a frozen three-camera capture. Associate each wrist to the head with calibrated geometry and commit confirmed scene instances. A fresh observation with history requires a Decisions identity verdict. Decisions binds each new task role to current registered IDs using the original instruction, Responses hints and measured robot-frame positions. Unique instances remain bound across moves. Unknown roles preserve committed physical IDs and request graph recovery.
capability: Ground task references in frozen RGBD before any identity-dependent skill
